messages:
sophia (ml-eng): Heads-up — customer (FinCloud) requested support for neptune-13b model in Private with strict latency SLA (p99 < 220ms) for chat workloads.
pranav (mlinfra): Can you paste the model repo/link? any special ops or fused kernels?
sophia (ml-eng): Repo: https://git.internal/neptune/neptune-13b.git
sophia (ml-eng): Initial doc says custom rotary embeddings + grouped qkv. Might need kernel tweaks.
lee (prod-eng): Do we have baseline perf numbers? batch=1, seq=512?
sophia (ml-eng): Quick local run on rtx-a5000: seq=512, batch=1 -> 320ms p99, tokens/sec ~ 15
sophia (ml-eng): Trying quant: q4f16 -> p99 240ms, q8_1 -> 190ms but accuracy drops ~1.8% on our convQA eval
eva (solutions): Customer needs HIPAA; also asks for deterministic outputs and token-level cost estimate.
pranav (mlinfra): I'll queue a dedicated quant job on quant-cluster-2. @onboard-bot please create a triage ticket.
onboard-bot: Ticket #IN-9832 created: neptune-13b private onboarding. Assignee: pranav (mlinfra).
lee (prod-eng): Action items: (1) full quant sweep (q4f16,q8_1,q8_2) with eval set, (2) perf matrix across a100/p4d, (3) kernel patch review if grouped qkv slow.
sophia (ml-eng): I'll run eval set and post diff metrics by EOD. Quick note: run command I used:
```
./serve_bench --model neptune-13b --seq 512 --batch 1 --quant q4f16 --device a5000
```
pranav (mlinfra): I'll reserve a100 nodes and run a smoke matrix tomorrow morning.
eva (solutions): I'll prep a brief for the customer about tradeoffs (latency vs quality vs cost).
sophia (ml-eng): Also flagging potential regression: q8_1 reduced F1 by 1.8%, need to confirm if it's prompt-related.
lee (prod-eng): If quant cannot meet SLA without large quality hit, propose dedicated faster instance for them.
sophia (ml-eng): Ok. tagging @pranav @lee. I'll upload eval diffs to ticket #IN-9832 when ready. :thumbsup:
